decision.reason: [ev-df7e89106890] is a single changelog line. It says only that Loki 3.0.0 no longer puts label names into the "route" label of request metrics, and it links to PR 11551 for details. It doesn't say which HTTP/gRPC routes or endpoints were affected, what the route value was before or is now, or which deployments, components or metric series are involved. Without that, there isn't enough to write the applicability condition. The PR or the code diff is needed to show which routes are affected and what the old and new route values are.
